brief.zh: 像数拍一样输出自「重来」起过了几拍，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍不算：那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Count the ticks since restart as before, except that ticks on which hold is 1 do not count: on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 内容里有 01111110 时，帧会被从中间切断；要在内容里多塞一位把它拆开，别的都得等一拍。可<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>每拍都往前走。
t.en: When the content holds 01111110 the frame is cut in two, and slipping in an extra bit to break it up means everything else must wait a tick. But <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> moves on every tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」和「暂停」同时为 1 时，「重来」优先。
hint.en: When restart and hold are both 1, restart wins.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.
